_comment: Per-machine planned-hours baseline master. This is the denominator for utilisation and output-efficiency. It does NOT change how output/hours are read from the sheets; it only sets the target each machine is measured against. A machine with no entry here falls back to the sheet's flat placeholder and is flagged 'baseline not set'. Edit this file to add machines; no code change needed. 'machines' keys are matched case- and whitespace-insensitively against the full machine code (e.g. 'MOULDING M/C - 4'). 'overrides' lets a specific YYYY-MM use different planned hours. 'ideal_output_rate' (units/hour) is optional; when omitted, output-efficiency keeps the sheet's own ideal-output figure.

MOULDING M/C - 4.basis: 2 shifts x 12h x 26 working days = 624 h/month

MOULDING M/C - 22.basis: 2 shifts x 12h x 26 working days = 624 h/month
